steps.content: Surrounded and attacked from all sides, Hella is driven back, step by step, pressed deeper into the maze's heart.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If this keeps up, she's gonna catch me for sure...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Think, THINK! There's gotta be another way!
At the next narrow turn, she explodes into motion. Her silhouette blurs, vanishing around the corner in an instant.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh?
With the prey out of sight, the hunter hesitates momentarily before momentum carries her around the corner.
CLANG—! Metal rings out as fragments scatter in all directions.
The strike comes from the blind spot. Hella, coiled in the shadows of the inner corner, lashes out. Her weapon meets Synex's mask with a shattering impact. But she can't press closer.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Haha... Hahahaha!! Well done!
Beneath the broken mask, a pair of eyes gleam—wild, unhinged, alight with manic delight.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You did this on purpose... You knew we'd come if you told us about this place... Just like what happened to the last person who found that photo...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Everyone else who found out the truth was killed by you people!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oops, looks like I missed a spot. Was it that little runaway? Did she actually make it to DisCity?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Ah, but who cares? The real fun part is... you all took the bait.
As if satisfied with Hella's expression, Synex's smile grows even more taunting.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Ah, <color=#fb9259>Hypercubes</color>... For years, DisCity's kept its precious Mania-resistance resource under lock and key. How it's made? How it's mined? Nobody knows. Most poor souls waste their lives scrambling for scraps.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Fraser slaved away at that research for ages—right up until this little project was about to crumble... Then along came some very special guests.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: They brought secrets of the <color=#fb9259>Black Ring</color>.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So, Fraser is really working with the Underground! Do you all have a death wish?!
Synex gives no definitive answer, laughing with uninhibited delight.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: We just can't let a few squeaking little rats ruin a big plan like this, you know. So the Shadow Operatives have to... clean up the loose ends.
The woman lifts Hella's chin with one finger, her voice laced with something almost like tenderness.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: However...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: I've just found you, my precious little prey... Wouldn't it be such a shame to cut our game short?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Honestly, I don't really care about Hypercubes, DisCity, or Fraser... If they actually got what they wanted, it'd be so boring.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: So, I have a different plan, something much more fun. Would you play with me instead, little Hella?
Hella speaks very softly, prompting Synex to instinctively lean in closer to hear.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hmm?
Slap—!!!

A sharp, resounding slap splits the air as Hella drives her palm across Synex's face with every ounce of strength she has. The force of the blow catches Synex off guard, just enough for Hella to wrench herself free from her captor's grip.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Go **** yourself!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You really think you can buy me that easy? Couldn't con me into talking about the shackles during the day, so now you're pulling this shady night-time bullshit?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That slap was your lesson! Remember to ask nicely before trying to haggle in your next life!
Quickly dropping low, Hella rolls across the rough ground, fingers clawing for gravel. In one fluid motion, she flings the jagged stones straight for Synex's eyes. The moment Synex dodges—
Hella bolts away without a backward glance. Behind her, only chaos remains, and Synex, fingertips brushing the livid mark staining her cheek.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Ouch... still got that fiery temper.
[Fade Out to Switch Scene]
After running for a while, Hella sprints past a junction. Close behind her—like relentless shadows—come the guttural growls of beasts and the ever-nearing laughter of her pursuer.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh, Hella, sweetheart—are you going to keep running? I'm getting bored with this game—
Another sharp turn! Hella, gasping for air, stumbles into the junction, only for her heart to drop like a stone.
Before her looms a solid wall. A dead end.
Behind her, the chaotic footsteps of her hunters and Synex's mocking laughter are just a breath away—no time to turn back now.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Without Legion or Hypatia to help you, where do you think you're running? Or maybe... you'd like to crawl into a hole again, like last time?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Too bad for you, my nose never misses a scent. I'll find you... no matter how deep you dig...
"Into a hole"...?
Then, an idea flashes through her mind. Hella drops to her knees, frantically scraping her hands across the ground—until her fingers brush against something small, cold, and unmistakably metallic.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Come on, come on... There's no time left!
Click. A familiar mechanical whirr, and the wall splits open, revealing a hidden passage.
The shadows of her pursuers round the corner. With no time to hesitate, Hella grits her teeth, tucks her body tight, and hurls herself inside—

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: —WAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!
The moment she leaps, her feet find nothing but air as she plummets down a smooth, steep tunnel, swallowed whole by the darkness below.
[Background - Refugee Camp]
After sliding down the passage for who knows how long, a thoroughly dizzy and disoriented Hella is finally spat out by the pipe with a wet plop.
Then... SPLASH! She plunges into a pool of water.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh... Where am I... blegh...

Gasping, she thrashes wildly, limbs heavy with exhaustion. With one final heave, she drags herself onto solid ground and collapses, chest heaving. But before she can even catch her breath, she hears something rustling nearby.
Her head snaps up. Against the dim light filtering from above, bizarre, jagged shadows slither into view, encircling her.
More pursuers? Every muscle in her body coils tight, ready to strike—until one shadow detaches itself from the rest. A figure steps forward.
You are...?
